benchmarks.name: yam_lift_cube
benchmarks.behavior_goal: grasp the cube, lift it clear of the table, and hold it steadily
known_limitations: the mjlab rollout archive does not yet persist end-effector pose, object pose, gripper contact, or grasp state
no hand-authored held-out lift-and-hold success specification has passed the adversarial audit battery
no frozen evaluation seed/world split exists for this task
benchmarks.notes: A real registered mjlab arm task and the first required gripper-dependent frontier. It is intentionally visible but impossible to launch as a benchmark until its evaluator authority exists.

benchmarks.name: yam_multi_cube_lift
benchmarks.behavior_goal: identify, grasp, and lift the requested cube while leaving the other cubes undisturbed
known_limitations: the selected target identity and all cube poses are absent from the generic rollout artifact contract
the current metric interface cannot distinguish target-cube success from lifting a distractor
no disturbance predicate or held-out object-layout split is frozen
benchmarks.notes: Longer-horizon multi-object arm frontier. Do not replace the missing object semantics with mean return or generic joint-motion proxies.
